cues.text: The dorm's front lobby. Akihiko staggers in through the front door, clutching his side, and slumps to the floor against the wall. Mitsuru and Yukari come running, Ikutsuki close behind.
Yukari runs to Akihiko and kneels beside him.
A heavy crash shakes the building. Everyone startles; Ikutsuki whirls around, and Yukari jumps to her feet.
Yukari runs off toward the stairs.
